profile_comparison.scope: single separately instrumented CI run per revision; profiles include startup/warmup/idle direct phases/Weir measurement/drain; overlapping cumulative call chains must not be added; not capacity or causal proof

before: Showing nodes accounting for 14.84s, 99.69% of 14.88s total
after: Showing nodes accounting for 17.37s, 99.77% of 17.41s total

after.source: independently decoded PrepareBatch child call tree; omitted from top-150 listing

profile_comparison.conclusion: Removed redundant operation preparation/URI validation is supported by a much smaller preparation call tree. Remaining response validation, allocation/GC, runtime scheduling/result retention and transport completion contention are candidates only; current evidence does not establish another causal throughput root cause.

limitations: Linux production executable and profiling helper are not included in uploaded artifact; SHA identity is bound by manifest/provenance/build receipt and successful pinned preparation step, rather than independent rehash of absent Linux binaries. Uploaded wrapper and raw profiles were independently hashed; local production/native Mongo binaries were independently hashed.
Fault scenario proves graceful owner withdrawal/restart and seed loss; it does not claim hard-kill lease convergence or business write replay.
Adapter histogram proves one adapter invocation for the 513-item unary batch, not a general guarantee of one database wire command.
Comparison smoke validates identical plans, persisted results and transports; its tiny fixed-operation ratios are not capacity evidence.
Declared process memory budget is admission configuration, not OS memory reservation.
Cleanup assessment reads exact owner receipts and lifecycle code; no existing service or container was started or manipulated during this audit.
